description: Score upcoming releases for a currency pair using release-calendar proximity and indicator-level heuristics. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

horizon_events.description: Maximum release events per currency to score.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

name: release_risk_score_task
title: Release Risk Score Task
